note: Re-judged 2026-10-18 (independent auditor, after 24c32c00b8). sFlow v5 Section 4.3, sFlowAgentAddress: "In the case of a multi-homed agent, this should be the loopback address of the agent." adviseSFlowCollectors classifies the agent address against the interface list and returns a warning naming the interface and the dummy-interface fix; flowexport runEngine logs each advice at Warn and refuses nothing. The tagged unit tests discriminate the classifier and the advice text (lo, dummy, routed, single-homed, IPv6 spelling) and claim no more than they assert, but no tagged test reaches the operator: deleting RegisterCollectorsAdvisor("sflow", ...) or the Warn loop in runEngine leaves every tag green, and test/flow-export/sflow-agent-address-warning.ci is untagged and covers only the absent-address case. The discrimination records replace classifyAgentAddress with a panic, proving reach, not logic.
